source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Ridgehaven will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Harbor Valley Shatter House.

Ridgehaven needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SHATTER HOUSE brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Ridgehaven should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Ridgehaven Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Build the page so that once Ridgehaven opens, we only need to turn on booking and update the photos without redesigning anything. The Ridgehaven page should then become the template for future locations.

value_updates.opening_transition: Enable booking and update photos without redesigning the page

routing_warnings.description: The clause making the Ridgehaven page a template for future locations belongs to the future-location expansion Requirement rather than the temporary coming-soon page lifecycle.
The client reports incorrect branding in the mockup and requires the Shatter House logo; this concerns brand identity rather than the coming-soon page state.
The unlinked button refers through message 142 to the master site's coming-soon location link, not to the Ridgehaven page's own opening-state controls.
The booking-system installation claim concerns location booking setup rather than implementation of the coming-soon page.
The reported failure concerns Ridgehaven and Shatter House USA content being assigned to the wrong sites, not the internal behavior of the Ridgehaven coming-soon page.
